Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around another specification, CoffeeCan, adding Apalache-oriented type annotations while keeping the original specification separate. It declares a maximum bean count constant and a single variable can with a record-shaped type annotation indicating black and white bean counts as integers. The file itself does not define the algorithm dynamics, actions, or temporal properties; instead, it instances the CoffeeCan module and provides no local behavior beyond declarations and comments.
